A wide, empty multi-lane city street recedes toward a cluster of tall buildings under a clear blue sky. A large brick building with rows of dark windows lines the left side behind an orange construction barrier and green fencing, while a modern gray building with a glass canopy and blue mailboxes occupies the right foreground. Trees stand along both sidewalks, and lane markings run down the center of the asphalt.
